Covers live related views, focus and SVG identity, persistence, clipboard copy, local view settings, stale commands, interrupted playback, dark startup and narrow layout. All 75 final checks pass after recording the checked M0 candidate and next G1 judgment in roadmap, active thread and source-linked vision. No visual acceptance or matrix scope claimed.

Final independent production builds and both complete scoped typechecks pass against accepted 1c1e8791. Notebook initial gzip 466189 to 470920 bytes; complete JS/CSS 519265 to 549119.
